The '''''Vermin-Thrax''''' was a [[HCT-2001 Dragonboat-class Reugeot 905 freighter/Legends|HCT-2001 ''Dragonboat''-class Reugeot 905 freighter]] was used by the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] hunters of [[Garnac/Legends|Garnac's]] [[Garnac's hunting guild/Legends|hunting guild]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Description==
The slave ship had dual, forward-facing [[Retrorocket/Legends|braking thrusters]] to aid in landing procedures.<ref name="EGPL">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode321.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Padawan Lost}}</ref> It was equipped with at least 12 cargo modules located at the stern of the ship and it was armed with at least one chain gun turret.<ref name="PL" />

==History==
The Trandoshans abducted aliens of various species, including [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Initiates]] [[Jinx/Legends|Jinx]], [[Kalifa/Legends|Kalifa]], and [[O-Mer/Legends|O-Mer]], and held them in cages on this ship. ''Reugeot 905'', was used to ferry these kidnapped beings to the isolated jungle moon of [[Wasskah/Legends|Wasskah]]. After the captives were brought to the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of Wasskah and released into jungle, the Trandoshans would hunt them for sport. In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], they kidnapped [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] who rallied the surviving Initiates and, with the aide of fellow captive, the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], [[Battle on Wasskah/Legends|defeated]] the group of hunters.<ref name="PL" />

{{Ship-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Originally, the episode guide for "[[Wookiee Hunt]]" identified the ship as the ''Reugeot 905''. However, ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Incredible Vehicles]]'' named the ship as the ''Vermin-Thrax''. [[The Official Star Wars Fact File Part 30|''The Official Star Wars Fact File'' Part 30]] later resolved the inconsistency by attributing "Reugeot 905" to part of the ship's class designation, while reinforcing the ''Vermin-Thrax'' as the individual ship's name.
